podcast.body: This song, featured on the "Year Zero" album, was later released on April 26, 2007, in the GarageBand format for Mac computers. This release specifically encouraged fans to remix the track, with its multi-tracks containing additional hidden clues integral to the Alternate Reality Game.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: One of the singles from the "Year Zero" album. "This is one of the singles from Year Zero. It's Capital G."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was a single from the *Year Zero* album. The "G" in the title stands for both "greed" and for George W. Bush. "A track called Capital G was a single for the record and the G stands for greed and it also stands for George W. Bush."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
